name: Vidden: Ulriken to Fløyen
why: Bergen's classic day walk across the open plateau between its two city mountains, with the fjords and the North Sea on one side and the city below.
book: Free. Ulriken cable car up, Fløibanen funicular down (paid).
dangers: Fog and rain are common: carry a map.

points.name: Ulriken
points.note: The highest of Bergen's seven mountains, 643 m, with a cable car.

points.name: Fløyen
points.note: The city mountain with the funicular down to the old town.
